title: EKODI-owned virtualization sovereignty
summary: Require EKODI-owned browser/runtime/desktop virtualization to be the default whenever virtualization is needed, while treating external virtualization or computer-use providers as audited, temporary and replaceable fallback adapters only.
approvalBasis: The platform owner explicitly instructed EKODI on 2026-09-22 to make it a mandatory rule that when virtualization is needed, EKODI should develop, complete and use its own virtualization service rather than normalize an external service as the default.
adds: audited external fallback with native capability gap registration
rollbackPlan: Revert this amendment and the associated constitutional/policy/validator changes through the guarded C2 change path. Do not weaken existing security, isolation, audit, provider-independence or production-release gates during rollback.
